request: Git status line counts: a tracked file whose mode alone changed (chmod +x) is reported with every line added. Only new (untracked) files should fall back to counting lines on disk; a mode-only change is 0 added, 0 removed (git_status_blocking in src-tauri/src/git.rs). Also: in default_remote_name and fetch refspecs skip remote names that aren't UTF-8 instead of panicking, and show non-UTF-8 paths lossily in status.
